rationale: Louan's applied ML work on neuroimaging pipelines (fMRI analysis, lesion detection) could benefit from Jiale's deep expertise in distributed training systems and ML infrastructure at Meta—taking domain-specific models from research into production-scale deployment. Both are based in San Francisco and working at the intersection of deep learning systems, making this a natural technical collaboration opportunity around scaling medical imaging applications.
intro_message: Louan, meet Jiale Zhi — he builds ML infrastructure and distributed training systems at Meta and could help you think through scaling your neuroimaging pipelines from research into production.
